 Self-learning AI releases NFL picks, score predictions for every Week 9 game
 SportsLine AI evaluated the Week 9 NFL odds and revealed its NFL score predictions and best NFL picks
 By
 Daniel Kohn 
 Nov 8, 2026
 at
 11:21 am ET 
 •
 3 min read
 Imagn Images 
 Several interconference matchups highlight Week 9 despite two teams having byes -- the Steelers and Titans. Among the top interconference games include Browns vs. Saints (-3), Cowboys vs. Colts (+4.5), Broncos vs. Panthers (+2.5), Lions vs. Dolphins (+6.5), Packers vs. Patriots (-3), Raiders vs. 49ers (-9.5), and Bills vs. Vikings (+3) on 'Monday Night Football.' There are a few key divisional matchups as well, including Giants vs. Eagles (+3), with Joe Milton making his first career start for Philly, and Cardinals vs. Seahawks (-8.5), with Sam Darnold (quad) ruled out and Gardner Minshew under center for the Cards.  Week 9 also features a key NFC matchup on 'Sunday Night Football.' That's when the visiting Tampa Bay Buccaneers take on the Chicago Bears (-6) as Chicago looks to build off its big win at Seattle in Week 8. Tampa is coming off back-to-back wins, both coming since Baker Mayfield returned under center.  Built using cutting-edge artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques by SportsLine's Data Science team, AI Predictions and AI Ratings are generated for each game. The AI predictions are determined by statistically learning from each team's historical data and then quantitatively evaluating the strength of the opponent's defense by assigning a numeric value out of 100 called a matchup score. It continuously refreshes on the most recent available data and can help you spot the biggest discrepancies in the lines at NFL betting sites , and has hit thousands of 4.5- and 5-star prop picks since the start of the 2023 season.

 Top Week 9 NFL AI picks
 After analyzing every game in Week 9, SportsLine AI is projecting a 23-20 win by the Packers over the Patriots. The Patriots, who won the AFC East title a year ago, are second in the division at 5-3, behind the 6-1 Bills. The Packers, meanwhile, are 5-3, one of four teams in the NFC North with five wins or more. Green Bay is coming off 27-19 victory over the Carolina Panthers on Oct. 29. 
 The Packers are led by quarterback Jordan Love, who has completed 61.5% of his passes for 2,246 yards and 16 touchdowns with six interceptions. He has also rushed for one touchdown. Wide receiver Christian Watson has 42 receptions for 708 yards (16.9 average) and six touchdowns. He has 13 big plays of 20 or more yards, including a long of 81.
 Third-year veteran quarterback Drake Maye leads the New England offense. In eight starts, he has completed 67.1% of his passes for 1,983 yards and 15 touchdowns. He has been intercepted eight times. His top target has been tight end Hunter Henry, who has 29 receptions for 326 yards and two touchdowns. Henry (foot) is listed as questionable. A.J. Brown (knee) and TreVeyon Henderson (illness) have been ruled out for the Pats. 
 SportsLine AI is going Under (44.5) and likes the Packers (+3) as the better value for ATS picks.  See its other Week 9 football predictions and football picks at SportsLine .
